newsitem.title: UK: BRIT to buy 10 pct of Lloyd's agent Wren.
newsitem.headline: BRIT to buy 10 pct of Lloyd's agent Wren.

text.p: Benfield & Rea Investment Trust (BRIT) has said it is to buy 10 percent of Lloyd's of London agent Wren.
BRIT earlier this month launched a 78 million stg bid for HCG Lloyd's Investment Trust, topping a proposed 72 million stg merger between HCG and CLM Insurance Fund.
It said then it was to buy a minority stake in Wren, which would advise HCG to manage HCG's underwriting portfolio.
An offer document from BRIT posted on Thursday night revealed that the investment trust planned to buy 10 percent of Wren for 1.5 million stg.
Wren has also aligned itself with another corporate backer in the insurance market, Finsbury Underwriting, which said on Friday it will acquire a 20 percent stake in Wren.
Finsbury said it had agreed to modify the terms of an advisory agreement with Wren to enable the agent to accept an appointment as Lloyd's advisor to BRIT.
BRIT's offer for HCG valued the trust at 80.5 million stg or 123.5 pence per share at the close on August 28. HCG shares were unchanged at 120-1/2p on Friday.
CLM has responded to the BRIT offer document by urging HCG shareholders to accept its offer for HCG.
Nobody at HCG was immediately available for comment.
